evidence.title: GitHub - itshover/itshover: Icons that move with intent · GitHub

name: Its Hover
summary: Open source library of animated SVG icons shipped as editable React components and installable from a shadcn registry.
description: Animated icons built with React and Motion, distributed through a shadcn registry: each icon installs with npx shadcn add https://itshover.com/r/<name>.json and works with Next.js, shadcn and modern design systems. Icons cover UI essentials, social, tech, actions, currency and status, and the site also shows community examples of animated components (sidebar, navbar, dock, profile dropdown).
contains: 186+ animated icons: UI essentials, social, tech, actions, currency, status
each icon is a React component animated with motion/react on hover
install via npx shadcn add https://itshover.com/r/<icon>.json
example gallery of animated components: sidebar, navbar, dock, profile dropdown
Apache-2.0 licensed; built with Next.js 16, React 18+, Motion and Tailwind CSS 4
